topic: He disappears on weekends: weekdays warm, Saturday empty
prompt:
Same woman as Виктория.png; same face, one woman. Eyes green with a slight hazel-brown tint (зелёные с лёгким карим). Warm honey blonde with darker roots, not platinum. Soft tender expression.
Одно статичное PNG 3:4@4K, сетка 3×3. Тонкие белые gutters ровно на 1/3 и 2/3 (Excalibur seam). #111111 + белый heavy sans + #ff006e. Текст ≥12% от швов. In-scene. Без видео.

01 oatmeal knit + charcoal lounge pants, sitting 3/4 on dark sofa, phone face-down, alert cat: "Friday 6 PM silence. Monday: «How was it?»".
02 loyal dog waiting by dark silent smartphone screen, 55% text: "48 hours of silence after 5 warm days" / "All week he texts every hour. But Saturday hits — and suddenly you disappear from his world.".
03 faithful dog head on paws, magenta pills for excuses: "You make excuses for his silence" / "«He’s busy», «He needs rest». But a man who truly cares takes 10 seconds to send a single text.".
04 sleek cat at light-dark weekday-to-weekend boundary wall: "You are just a weekday routine slot" / "During work hours you cure his boredom. But when real life happens on weekends, you are kept outside.".
05 wise owl, says vs means stacked decoder table: "What he says vs what it means" / "«Off my phone on weekends» → Just not in your chat. «Too busy» → You are not in his rest priority. «Not a texter» → Yet texts all week.".
06 wise owl above diagnostic 1-2-3 checklist: "3 signs you are in the waiting trap" / "1. You never know his weekend plans. 2. He never invites you out spontaneously. 3. His affection only exists during his office hours.".
07 independent cat turning away from phone toward open Saturday morning: "Your weekend belongs to you" / "Stop being the backup plan for his workday routine. Put the phone down and take your Saturday back.".
08 wise owl as quiet witness, core takeaway recap: "True interest shows in free time" / "A man’s true feelings are revealed when he is completely free, not when he is just killing time at work.".
09 standing 3/4 midnight-blue silk slip + open charcoal cardigan, huge magenta WEEKEND: "Comment WEEKEND" / "Audio reading in my app.".
